project: UI Dashboard Stream and Timeline Split (U8 Recovery v2)
description: Recovery implementation of the dashboard stream/timeline split (U8): isolate factory SSE transport, session lifecycle resets, and world-view shell derivation behind focused hooks while preserving DashboardScreen loading, error, pause, refresh, and snapshot behavior. Retriggers after wave-2 plan failure on U2; baseline spec at tasks/prd-ui-dashboard-stream-timeline-split.md. Requires ui-session-scope-context-recovery-v2 complete first.

context.customerAsk: Retrigger U8 (UI dashboard stream timeline split) after the prior recovery token blocked on failed U2 recovery. Deliver the split hook seams from tasks/prd-ui-dashboard-stream-timeline-split.md so live dashboard stream, timeline, and shell states remain correct with testable ownership.
context.problem: useDashboardSnapshot combined SSE transport, session-switch resets, queued timeline appends, debug memory hooks, and snapshot projection, making the dashboard shell hard to test and causing fragile loading/error derivation from snapshot truthiness instead of stream plus timeline event ownership.
context.solution: Extract useFactoryEventStream, useDashboardSessionLifecycle, and useDashboardWorldView; keep useDashboardSnapshot as a thin composer wired through useDashboardSession for rawSessionID and isPaused; gate timeline memory debug behind existing flags; prove behavior with focused hook tests and dashboard shell stream/timeline regressions.

acceptanceCriteria: useFactoryEventStream owns session-scoped SSE open/close, stream status, queued onEvent delivery, and FACTORY_CHANGE query sync; pause disables live connection with existing offline copy

useDashboardSessionLifecycle resets timeline, localized stream state, selection history, and current-factory definition queries once per qualifying session or refreshToken change without duplicate removeQueries
useDashboardWorldView derives isInitialLoading and error from stream state plus selectedTick===0 and eventCount===0, not snapshot truthiness alone
useDashboardSnapshot composes lifecycle, stream, world view, and optional debug in ≤80 LOC using useDashboardSession in production without dashboardSessionStore imports in stream modules
useDashboardTimelineMemoryDebug runs only when memoryDebug is enabled; default sessions install no debug globals or localStorage persistence
Dashboard shell regression proves loading, refresh reset, pause/resume, and session-scoped stream behavior without cross-session EventSource leaks
Typecheck, lint, and targeted UI tests pass for all touched areas

userStories.title: Factory event stream transport hook
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want SSE connection wiring isolated so I can test transport without mounting the full dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: useFactoryEventStream opens the session-scoped events URL, updates dashboardStreamStore status, compacts events before onEvent, and syncs FACTORY_CHANGE into current-factory React Query keys
When enabled is false for a selected session, no EventSource opens and stream state shows the paused offline message; re-enabling opens a new connection
refreshToken change closes and reopens the stream for the same sessionID; sessionID null never opens a stream

useFactoryEventStream.test.tsx covers open URL, paused/disabled, refresh reopen, resume-after-pause, offline-before-first-event, and factory-change query sync via replay harness or injected openStream
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Dashboard session lifecycle hook
userStories.description: As an operator switching factory tabs or refreshing the dashboard, I want prior session timeline, stream, selection, and factory-definition cache cleared once so I never see cross-session bleed.
acceptanceCriteria: useDashboardSessionLifecycle calls resetDashboardSessionScopedState on qualifying sessionID or refreshToken changes: timeline reset, localized stream reset, resetSelectionHistoryStore, and one removeQueries for CURRENT_FACTORY_DEFINITION_QUERY_KEY_PREFIX
shouldResetDashboardSessionScopedState skips initial mount for refreshToken 0 but resets on later refresh increments and session key changes
dashboard-session-lifecycle.test.ts and useDashboardSessionLifecycle.test.tsx prove no duplicate removes and correct reset on session switch versus first mount
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Dashboard world view and shell state derivation
userStories.description: As a dashboard user, I want the shell loading spinner and connection error to reflect stream progress before the first timeline event, not whether a cached snapshot object exists.
acceptanceCriteria: useDashboardWorldView selects worldViewCache[selectedTick] and exposes selectedTick, hasEvents, streamState, isInitialLoading, and error

deriveDashboardWorldViewShellState sets isInitialLoading only while rawSessionID is set, selectedTick is 0, eventCount is 0, and stream status is not offline; sets error from stream message only in the offline-before-first-event case
Unit tests for deriveDashboardWorldViewShellState cover connecting, offline-before-first-event, and post-first-event success paths
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Thin dashboard snapshot composer and screen wiring
userStories.description: As a reader of DashboardScreen, I want stream, lifecycle, and world-view concerns composed in one obvious place without re-embedding transport logic.
acceptanceCriteria: useDashboardSnapshot composes useDashboardSessionLifecycle, useFactoryEventStream with enabled from useDashboardSession rawSessionID and isPaused, useDashboardWorldView, and queued timeline append; file length is at most 80 lines

DashboardScreen continues to drive loading, error, empty, and success panels from useDashboardSnapshot with locale and refreshToken; DashboardBento keeps the existing snapshot contract without forking timeline ownership
useDashboardSnapshot.test.tsx proves refresh resets timeline to tick 0 with loading, streamed events append to timeline state, and default sessions do not enable timeline memory debug side effects
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: dashboard loads live stream, shows loading before first event, and recovers after refresh without stale cross-session UI

userStories.title: Optional timeline memory debug isolation
userStories.description: As a maintainer debugging timeline memory, I want debug globals and persistence opt-in only so normal operators are unaffected.
acceptanceCriteria: useDashboardTimelineMemoryDebug runs only when readFactoryTimelineDebugOptions().memoryDebug is true (?afMemoryDebug=1)
Default sessions do not set window __agentFactoryTimelineDebug__ or write agentFactory.timelineDebugSummary to localStorage; useDashboardTimelineMemoryDebug.test.tsx proves off and on paths
useDashboardSnapshot invokes the debug hook only from the composer; no behavior change for default users
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Dashboard stream/timeline shell regression proof
userStories.description: As an operator, I want confidence that session tab switches and pause/resume do not leak streams or show the wrong session timeline state.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing app-shell, Storybook, or integration regression exercises session-scoped stream URLs and observable shell outcomes: loading clears after first event, pause stops live connection, tab switch resets timeline and stream targets
Regression asserts observable timeline scrubber or shell status outcomes, not internal hook file names or module registration inventories
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill when the regression surface is Storybook-backed
